author: jrc2
name: Emojify
short: Add themed emoji prefixes to channel names.
description: Adds a themed emoji to the beginning of every channel name in a server. Supports holiday presets for Christmas and Halloween, or custom emoji input. Also includes a cleanup command to remove emoji prefixes.
install_msg: Thanks for installing Emojify! Use `[p]help emojify` to get started.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store or process user data.
